name: Longitudinal Vaginal Septum

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Imaging Diagnostic Criteria for Longitudinal Vaginal Septum

criteria.description: Presence of a longitudinal vaginal partition detected on physical examination
Confirmation of vaginal septum by pelvic MRI or ultrasound
Symptoms such as dyspareunia, obstructed menstruation, or infertility associated with vaginal septum

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of a longitudinal vaginal partition on physical exam plus imaging confirmation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis may be delayed until adolescence or adulthood due to asymptomatic cases.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Palpable longitudinal vaginal septum on gynecological examination
Bifid vaginal canal visualized on imaging
searchTerms: bifid vaginal structure seen on scan
painful intercourse due to vaginal septum
pain during sex related to vaginal obstruction
pain or discomfort during vaginal penetration

occasional.symptomName: Recurrent vaginal infections due to altered anatomy
searchTerms: repeated vaginal infections from structural issues
pelvic pain not linked to periods
chronic pelvic pain unrelated to cycle

occasional.symptomName: Urinary symptoms secondary to anatomical distortion
searchTerms: bladder issues related to vaginal structure

rare.symptomName: Vaginal hematocolpos due to obstructed menstrual flow
searchTerms: blood accumulation in vagina from blocked flow

rare.symptomName: Psychological distress related to sexual dysfunction
searchTerms: psychological issues related to sexual dysfunction
mental health impact of sexual difficulties

imaging: Pelvic MRI showing longitudinal vaginal septum
genetic: No specific genetic markers identified; may be associated with Mullerian duct developmental anomalies
other: Hysterosalpingography may show duplicated vaginal canal

distinguishingFeatures: Transverse rather than longitudinal vaginal partition
Presentation with primary amenorrhea due to outflow obstruction
Complete hymenal membrane obstructing vaginal opening
No longitudinal vaginal partition on examination or imaging

redFlags: Acute pelvic pain suggestive of infection or hematometra
references: American Journal of Obstetrics and Gynecology, 2020: Clinical features and management of longitudinal vaginal septum
